description: This file defines the ContentMethodsProvider class which implements IGlobalMethodProvider. It provides methods for creating, updating, and deleting content items within OrchardCore CMS, including methods like newContentItem, createContentItem, updateContentItem, and deleteContentItem.

classes.name: ContentMethodsProvider
classes.description: A provider class that supplies scripting methods for content item operations in OrchardCore.

methods.name: GetMethods
methods.description: Returns a collection of globally available methods related to content item management.
